name: Custom Shape Wooden Puzzle With Wooden Base
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - The product is crafted from two layers of high-quality wood, each with a thickness of 3mm, ensuring durability, stability, and a premium finish.
    - Puzzle pieces: Wooden 3mm thickness.
    - Comes with a solid wooden base for stable display.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Puzzle Size: 
    5 x 5 inches ~ 12.7 x 12.7 cm
    6 x 6 inches ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm

        10 x 10 inches ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm

       - Wooden Base Dimensions:
→ Width: 3.94 in (10 cm) and 7.87in (20cm)
→ Height: 0.98 in (2.5 cm)
→ Slot depth: approx. 0.59 in (1.5 cm)
- Puzzle piece minimum size: 2 cm
- Designed to fit perfectly into the base for easy assembly and display.
📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology, ensuring vibrant, crisp, and long-lasting colors. High-resolution details for personalized names, artwork, or icons.
    - Double-sided printing, ensuring a beautiful appearance from both the front and back.
    - You can choose whether to print on the wooden base or not; if selected, printing is applied to the front side of the base only.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Can be used as a decorative display item for desks, shelves, nightstands, or living rooms.
    - Functions as an interactive puzzle, creating a fun and meaningful experience.
    - Helps strengthen emotional connections while assembling personalized memories.
    - Easy to assemble and disassemble, suitable for all ages.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and personalized gift suitable for everyone.
    - Ideal for Valentine’s Day, anniversaries, weddings, birthdays, Christmas, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, or any special occasion.
    - A unique keepsake that combines decoration, entertainment, and emotional value.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape Wooden Puzzle With Stand

 

PRODUCTION

  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
